title: March 19, 2018 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
TUESDAY, MARCH 19, 2018 
9:00 AM 
AUSTIN CITY HALL 
301 W. 2ND STREET 
AUSTIN, TX 78701 
 
 
Press Conference 
 
9:00 AM 
Attend a press conference regarding an acknowledgment of the upcoming 90th 
Anniversary of the 1928 Master Plan, and invitation to the community for 
proclamation on March 22, 2018. 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
